newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed, Texas Instruments get pact.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed, Texas Instruments get pact.

text.p: A joint venture company owned by units of Lockheed Martin Corp. and Texas Instruments Inc. said Friday it has received a three-year missile contract worth $745 million from the U.S. Defence Department.

The TI/Martin Javelin joint venture received the contract for full-rate production of the Javelin antiarmor missile system. The contract is expected to be completed by fiscal year 2001, the company said.
The principal contractors in the joint venture are Texas Instruments Defence Systems and Electronics and Lockheed Martin Electronics and Missiles.
Lockheed's stock dipped 12.5 cents to $92.875, while Texas Instruments rose $1.50 to $89, both in consolidated afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
